summary: New Pacific Metals Corp. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on August 17, 2026, announcing via exhibit 99.1 (news release dated August 14, 2026) the filing of an independent preliminary economic assessment (PEA) technical report for its Carangas silver-gold project in Bolivia. The report, prepared by Ausenco Engineering Canada ULC per NI 43-101 with an effective date of July 16, 2026, contains no material differences from the prior July 17, 2026 news release. This is a routine technical disclosure for a mining development company, not a special-situation corporate event.
